scope: Execute qualified source-bound NTFS directory capture in the existing owned Windows reader and reconstruct every directory/profile/prefix/domain/receipt relationship from retained responses in the parent. Preserve bootstrap v1 behavior. This advances original NTFS development without public directory dispatch, namespace/content, physical source, writer or full0.1.0 admission.
ownership: Extend existing NtfsSnapshotInput, ntfs_snapshot.h/.cpp, NtfsWorker and its test probes. Keep one process host, role, payload mapping, parser family and snapshot lifetime model. Directory verification is an independent consumer of the existing pure runtime observer, not an invocation of the native file opener. Do not add a duplicate opener, scheduler, provider tree or speculative production hierarchy.
input: Add private NtfsSnapshotKind Bootstrap/Directory plus requested full directory reference and NtfsDirectoryLimits. Default Bootstrap retains its exact v1 wire shape/schema; nondefault directory controls in Bootstrap and unknown enum values reject. Directory uses org.disked.ntfs-directory-source-request/1 with exact additional directory_reference/directory_limits. Bind nonzero capture epoch, expected ordinary-file metadata, path/window, profile/capture limits and directory controls before spawn. Snapshot and host own copies. Normal binaries reject all test fixture selections.
frame: Directory uses org.disked.ntfs-directory-region-frame/1 and existing directory-file result schema. Bind exact input/epoch, actual process identity, result and every ordered response including native seek/read attempt/error/refusal/bytes. Existing worker publication/host envelopes may remain generic NTFS v1 because request digest and exact payload input/frame schema bind the selected kind. Bootstrap frames/result/claims/context remain unchanged. Directory context image_profile is ordinary-file-ntfs-directory.
reconstruction: After strict common metadata/provenance/budget checks, run the pure directory observer over retained responses. Explicit and automatic3.1 must consume the whole frame. Automatic3.0 first runs the3.1 observer to derive its exact natural bootstrap prefix count, rather than trusting the receipt. Require supported Volume3.0 and ntfs_volume_version with satisfied bootstrap prerequisites; validate the same prefix under3.0, deliberately stop at its first new read, and compare the contract-defined common foundation with only profile_matches normalized. Require complete prefix consumption, then reconstruct the selected full observation from all retained responses.
receipts: Recompute original probe hash/count, prefix-validation report hash, both normalized foundation hashes, attempted/validated/boundary/continued flags, reused/validation counts, selected profile/domain, full final replay and total replay counts. For automatic3.0 with prefix N and total R: pure passes2; replay_calls=N+R+(boundary?N:0); reused=boundary?N:0. Other directory modes have pure passes1 and replay_calls=R, zero/null prefix facts. Preserve legitimate pre-directory refusals without suffix. Reject adapter profile/replay disagreement, forged counts/hashes/provenance/limits/ref/input/claims or unknown fields; never repair child claims.
consistency: Derive metadata completeness/equality, binding/cancellation constraints and observed stability using the existing file-adapter rules. Structurally valid incomplete/error/changed/cancelled observations may be retained for inspection with applicability false; complete collection, valid frame, current source and future effects are different claims. Frame replay reads no native source and proves recorded relationships, not producer authenticity or renewed opening authority.
lifecycle: Reuse ObservationWorker launch/session/code/request/attempt/observer/worker/capture identities, inherited handles, job/process memory budgets, finite wait/cancel/retirement and real PID/creation checks. Prepare does not open/read source data; actual capture starts only after worker release. Snapshot is published only from validated completion after actual owned child exit and retains immutable result/context/optional frame after teardown. A live or uncertain child produces no admitted result. No new process scheduler or writer quiescence claim.
bounds: Keep input128KiB, payload8MiB and job128MiB. Source quotas are unchanged. Enforce directory input<=128KiB, observation<=2MiB (including post-binding diagnostic), capture receipt<=64KiB. At most512 responses and2MiB requested raw bytes yield<=4MiB hex; strict scalar metadata is<=1KiB per response, plus<=8KiB fixed wrapper. Conservative total is4MiB+2MiB+128KiB+512KiB+64KiB+8KiB=7020544 bytes, below8MiB. Canonical depth/value/string caps remain; encoding/memory/CPU/atomicity are separate limits. Do not enlarge timeouts/source limits for tests.
testing: Separate normal/fault libraries/probes and generated ordinary files only. Before evaluation define expected root/deep/fragmented/list/bitmap observations, both versions/profiles, automatic3.0 receipts, actual child/kernel/code/epoch identities and retained source hashes. Verify after source removal without reopening, inert preparation, immutable inputs, every new receipt/input/limit/ref/process/domain/hash/row/claim corruption and normal rejection of test controls. Exercise read/binding/replay faults, cancellation/hang/late/exit/startup failures, live publication and zero-time retirement; preserve old NTFS bootstrap/command/worker and common-worker results. Unavailable host/privilege checks stay unverified.
test_seam: Test-only capture_call is a canonical nonzero decimal string<=2048 selecting the relevant existing capture hook. Omission retains old defaults: after_read2, before_binding3, before_replay1. Normal builds reject it. Additional prefix receipt/hash worker mutations exist only in the fault composition. No fault-enabling environment protocol.
acceptance: Actual owned directory workers reproduce independent generated facts, exact retained bytes/profile-prefix/domain receipts and actual exited kernel process/code/epoch identities for both versions and profiles. Parent source-free verification survives removal; whole-file hashes stay unchanged.

Every malformed/forged directory input/frame/receipt/publication fails closed without a usable snapshot. Valid partial observations stay inspectable without applicability. Default bootstrap wires/outputs/contexts and normal/fault isolation remain compatible.

Measured bounded frame sizes remain below8MiB without source-budget growth. Real launch/wait/cancel/late/exit/retirement and retained ownership evidence, compiler/import/header/dependency checks, relevant native regressions, full tooling and current context/manifest/input hashes are retained. No owner, full platform/storage, public directory dispatch or release acceptance is manufactured.
